caption:
🏙️ Central London, every building standing today by year of construction — 1800 → 2025.

The Victorian boom fills the map in red and orange, terraces spreading along the new railways. The Blitz leaves a gap, then come post-war estates, the towers of the City and Canary Wharf, and the regeneration of the riverside.

📊 Data: building footprints OS OpenMap Local (OGL). Only about a sixth of these buildings have a recorded date (Colouring London); the rest are estimated from official counts of homes by construction period in each neighbourhood (VOA Council Tax stock) and from local history. Heights exaggerated ×3.
🌍 Map: OpenStreetMap contributors.
